rationale: All three prior blockers are resolved. CR-003 (commit format) is fixed — all 7 commits use EPMCDME-12616: prefix (verified by regex). CR-001 (EditWorkflowPage useEffect) and CR-002 (workflow endpoint rename) were scoped to the workflow-AI branch and are absent from this chargeback-only diff. Business acceptance criteria are all met.
